finalText:
**380 commits hold 14 user-visible changes.** Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

Three break things. Internal error types are no longer re-exported from `core`, `db`, `auth`, `jobs`, `billing`. The v1 export route is gone. An expired token returns 401, not 403.

One feature. Webhook deliveries retry with backoff. Ten fixes, the loudest being that request bodies stopped going to the logs.

Two calls to check. I cut the seven `perf` commits since your headings have no home for them. I also cut the `Ctx` to `RequestCtx` rename as internal.
